name: Hartford Stage Summer Studio Classes
description_short: Summer theatre programs for ages 5-18 run by Hartford Stage at the Greater Hartford Academy of the Arts, 9am-4pm: a teen musical, youth and junior musical productions, one-act plays, a children's cast, a book-to-stage week, a filmmakers lab and a technical theater track. Most end in a performance or share day; older programs include a Broadway trip.

sessions.name: Teen Musical: Once Upon a One More Time (ages 14-18)

sources.note: ZIP from the US Census geocoder for the street address the camp gives (359 Washington St, Hartford).

warnings: The page shows only the 2026 summer season (July 6 – August 7, 2026), which has already happened (today is 2026-10-13). No 2027 dates or prices are listed.

Availability reflects the page at the time it was read: Junior Troupe, One-Act Play and Technical Theater Track were sold out with a waitlist. Teen Musical and Youth Ensemble showed no register link or availability.

Prices vary widely by program. Multi-session discounts: Children's Cast $1,500 for both sessions; One-Act $1,500 for both; Day Dreamers $365 for 2 or $475 for 3; Junior Troupe $1,125 and Page to Stage $375 when combined.
Classes are held at the Greater Hartford Academy of the Arts, not at Hartford Stage's 50 Church Street address. The page does not give the Academy's address.

Day Dreamers runs half days (9 am – 12 pm) and is for Pre-K children who are potty trained. Children's Cast requires having finished Kindergarten. Broadway trip show (Death Becomes Her) is recommended for ages 12+.

refund_policy_summary: Withdraw by May 1 for a full refund. From May 1 to June 1 you get a refund minus 20%. After June 1 there are no refunds unless the spot is filled, then a refund minus 20%.
special_needs_notes: Children with special needs and health conditions are welcome; disclose needs at registration. The program cannot provide 1-on-1 support, so a school aide or accommodation must be provided at the family's expense. Contact the Studio Manager to discuss.
